Strategic targets, 2025

Oslo Havn's own goals against the result
Met
2 of 5
Missed
3
The bigger picture: both growth targets were met on a single-year basis in 2025, but cumulative 2022–25 cargo growth still stands at −10.6% against a +30% 2030 goal — a single strong year hasn't offset 2023's and 2024's declines. Cumulative passenger growth is −2.2% against +25%.
CO₂ from port activity is down 34% (prelim.) vs. its 2017 baseline — on track toward the −85% 2030 target, tracked separately from the annual scorecard above.
Årsberetning 2025, "Måloppnåelse" (fetched directly, 2026-09-24)
